title: SlowLab: Benchmarking Autonomous AI Agents on a Year of Experiments They Cannot Undo
abstract: arXiv:2610.34644v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous experimenters, yet the benchmarks that test them mostly offer cheap experiments that answer at once. Experiments in physical facilities are different: they take months, occupy scarce equipment and cannot be undone. We present SlowLab, a benchmark in which an agent runs a one-year campaign in four simulated greenhouse compartments on a site whose crop, facility and prices are hidden. The agent decides when to plant which climate policy, whether to stop a crop and which measurements to read while crops grow, and at the end recommends one policy, which a private evaluator scores in weather the agent never saw. In a preregistered study on 48 unseen sites, three low-cost language-model agents ended near a standard grower setting and clearly below a Bayesian-optimisation baseline that starts from that setting. translated_title: SlowLab：在无法撤销的一年期实验中评测自主AI智能体
translated_abstract: AI智能体越来越多地被提议作为自主实验者，然而测试它们的基准大多提供能够立即得到答案的廉价实验。实体设施中的实验则不同：它们需要数月时间，占用稀缺的设备，并且无法撤销。我们提出了SlowLab，这是一个基准测试，其中智能体在一个作物、设施和价格信息全部隐藏的场地上，在四个模拟温室舱室中开展为期一年的实验活动。智能体需要决定何时种植、采用哪种气候策略、是否终止某个作物，以及在作物生长期间读取哪些测量数据，最后推荐一个策略，该策略由一个私有评估者在智能体从未见过的天气条件下进行评分。在一项对48个未见场地进行的预注册研究中，三个低成本语言模型智能体的表现接近标准种植者设置，但明显低于从该设置出发的贝叶斯优化基线。它们将设施作为两个同步批次运行，因此生长期间获取的测量数据（原文在此处截断）
tldr: SlowLab是一个要求AI智能体在信息完全隐藏的模拟温室中完成一年期不可撤销实验的基准，预注册评测表明低成本语言模型智能体的表现仅接近标准种植者设置，明显逊于贝叶斯优化基线。
en_tdlr: SlowLab is a benchmark requiring AI agents to run a year-long, irreversible experimental campaign in simulated greenhouses with hidden site information, and preregistered evaluations show that low-cost LLM agents perform near a standard grower setting but clearly below a Bayesian-optimization baseline.
